title: termal_get_session_result reports totalBytes as characters, not UTF-8 bytes, for non-ASCII output
outcome: termal_get_session_result reports totalBytes as characters, not UTF-8 bytes, for non-ASCII output
acceptance: totalBytes reports the UTF-8 byte length of the complete output (or the field is renamed and documented to match what it counts), with a regression test using non-ASCII output.

outputOffset/outputLimit use the same documented unit as totalBytes, and a multi-page read of non-ASCII output reassembles the exact original bytes with no split or duplicated character, covered by a test.
